title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Shelf with Towel Bar, Solid Brass Wall Mount | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double with Towel Bar
description:
Upgrade everyday storage with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds display space and a convenient towel bar. This 16-inch Waverly Place collection piece uses 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and solid brass hardware, finished for enduring style in transitional bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Double glass shelf design adds two levels of storage
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
- Solid brass gallery rail helps keep items secure on the shelf
- Integrated towel bar keeps towels within reach
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, coordinated look

Specs:
- Category: Glass Shelves
- Collection: Waverly Place (matching Waverly Place)
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Size: 16-inch length; 12-inch height; 5-inch width; 5-inch projection
- Glass thickness: 0.38 inch
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Assembly: Not required
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors like pink, antique pewter, mediterranean blue, lavender, and golden yellow

A distinctive choice for transitional bathroom hardware where versatile bath accessories and finish options matter.

Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
